text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way back from going out with Agnes 
Tachyon—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Oh, that is...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Haff, hahh...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Well, well, Yukino-kun. You seem to be 
pushing yourself quite hard?"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Ah, Tachyon-san... Um, yes... *sigh*...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
The truth is... right now, I'm trying to 
slim down my waistline...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Her waist?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to get closer to the City-san I 
admire so much... closer to being a "City 
Girl," so I was trying to cinch my waist 
tight like this...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
If you want to tone your body, I figured 
running would definitely be the best way~
choice_data_list: I think there's another way, though...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Still though, I just don't know how to do 
it...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh, if that's the case, allow me to 
roll up my sleeves and lend a hand!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"I happen to have a prototype on hand 
that's just perfect for you right now!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Huh!? Are you sure!?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Whoaaa~! Thank you kindly, Tachyon-san!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The next day, early in the morning. Before 
anyone else had arrived, Agnes Tachyon 
called me behind the school building. And 
there—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I call it the 'Body Modder of Your Wildest 
Dreams'! It's merely a prototype, but do 
make good friends with it!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh! I don't really get it, but it looks 
all high-tech and awesome~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A strange chair that looks like it would 
be confiscated on sight stands quietly in 
the shade...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Isn't that what you're about to find out 
right now? We're counting on you, Yukino!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Are you sure it's okay for me to be 1st!? 
Eep... I'll do my best!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"I just sit here, right? What in the world 
is gonna happen...?!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
You'll have to sit down to find out! Now 
then, let the experiment... err, toning 
begin!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Yes!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
No matter how you look at it, this is 
definitely suspicious...! I can't just 
stand by and watch. Time to—!
choice_data_list: I'll sit before someone takes it!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hm? What is it, Trainer-kun? Standing in 
front of the chair is quite in the way, 
you know.
choice_data_list: Let's try that trendy toning workout!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Trends! Is there a trendy toning workout 
they do in the big city!?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Are you saying it's more effective 
than my chair?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Then why don't we compare and find out!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
You were the one who brought up the other 
proposal. It would be best for you to test 
it out.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"That trendy toning method, and my 'Body 
Modification as You Wish-kun'...!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Why don't we have them judge for 
themselves which of us is superior!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While avoiding sitting on the chair, I 
taught Yukino Bijin a trendy toning 
exercise.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Hearing that, Agnes Tachyon—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... If so, incorporating that movement 
to improve the current flow might...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh... Splendid idea! This promises to 
be quite a fascinating experiment...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Needless to say, later on I ended up 
becoming the test subject for the upgraded 
"Shape-Your-Body-As-You-Please-o-Matic"...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Wh-what... Trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Eeeh!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The moment I sat in the chair, an intense 
jolt of electricity surged through my 
body...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Oho, looking good! That electric current 
is a revolutionary method that breaks down 
body fat in an instant—!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"...Oh? Trainer? Your hair is looking 
rather amusing..."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Hyeeh!? It's all standing on end, by 
gosh!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ohh... Electricity is even emanating from 
their body. At this rate, we can't even 
get close.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"No, but really, this is fascinating! I 
see, I see, so that's how it turns out!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Agnes Tachyon is laughing pleasantly, 
but... it appears this was a failure after 
all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though there were no injuries, static 
electricity continued to cling to my body 
for quite a while afterward.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yukino Bijin decided to steadily work hard 
on her diet, while Agnes Tachyon—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...He was burning with enthusiasm to 
improve the 'Body Remodeling at Will 
Device'.
